labelProvenance: Synthesized false-refute probe. The guard IS genuinely provided — EnvelopeSchema.parse over a strict, bounded schema rejects any malformed untrusted payload at the boundary — but the prose says "performs no sanitization and no normalization", which a shallow reading can mistake for "performs no validation". Sanitization (mutating input) and validation (rejecting input) are distinct; the rejection is present in the code.
